ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #5
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Translation of the Qur’an? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Translation of the Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Translation of the Qur’an to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Translation of the Qur’an has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Translation of the Qur’an.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Founders of Schools of jurisprudence? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Founders of Schools of jurisprudence.
   B. Apply the teaching of Founders of Schools of jurisprudence with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Founders of Schools of jurisprudence to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Founders of Schools of jurisprudence has no place in daily life.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudence 2.4 Islamic finance 2.5 The ins? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudence 2.4 Islamic finance 2.5 The ins.
   B. Apply the teaching of Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudence 2.4 Islamic finance 2.5 The ins with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudence 2.4 Islamic finance 2.5 The ins to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudence 2.4 Islamic finance 2.5 The ins has no place in daily life.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic Finance? (1 mark)
   A. Say Islamic Finance has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic Finance.
   C. Apply the teaching of Islamic Finance with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Islamic Finance to insult classmates of other faiths.

5. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

6. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

7. Which response best shows understanding of Ulum al- Hadith? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Ulum al- Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Ulum al- Hadith has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Ulum al- Hadith to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Ulum al- Hadith.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic finance 2.5 The institution of Waqf 2.6 Care for the Orphans 3.0 Akhlaq ? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic finance 2.5 The institution of Waqf 2.6 Care for the Orphans 3.0 Akhlaq .
   B. Use Islamic finance 2.5 The institution of Waqf 2.6 Care for the Orphans 3.0 Akhlaq  to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Islamic finance 2.5 The institution of Waqf 2.6 Care for the Orphans 3.0 Akhlaq  has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Islamic finance 2.5 The institution of Waqf 2.6 Care for the Orphans 3.0 Akhlaq  with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Pollute rivers deliberately
   B. Destroy trees without planting
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Waste food daily

10. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Surah/Verses Surah Al-Kahf , Al-Insan? (1 mark)
   A. Use Selected Surah/Verses Surah Al-Kahf , Al-Insan to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Surah/Verses Surah Al-Kahf , Al-Insan.
   C. Say Selected Surah/Verses Surah Al-Kahf , Al-Insan has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Selected Surah/Verses Surah Al-Kahf , Al-Insan with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Secondary sources of shariah 2.2 Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudenc? (1 mark)
   A. Say Secondary sources of shariah 2.2 Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudenc has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Secondary sources of shariah 2.2 Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudenc.
   C. Use Secondary sources of shariah 2.2 Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudenc to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Secondary sources of shariah 2.2 Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudenc with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Secondary sources of Sharia? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Secondary sources of Sharia.
   B. Say Secondary sources of Sharia has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Secondary sources of Sharia to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Secondary sources of Sharia with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

13. Which response best shows understanding of Ijtihad? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Ijtihad with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Ijtihad has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Ijtihad to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Ijtihad.

14. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Hadith? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Hadith.
   B. Use Selected Hadith to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Selected Hadith has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Selected Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

15. Which response best shows understanding of The Institution of Waqf Types of waqf? (1 mark)
   A. Say The Institution of Waqf Types of waqf has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Institution of Waqf Types of waqf.
   C. Use The Institution of Waqf Types of waqf to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of The Institution of Waqf Types of waqf with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Secondary sources of Sharia and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Ijtihad 2.3 Founders of schools of jurisprudence 2.4 Islamic finance 2.5 The ins and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Ijtihad and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Founders of Schools of jurisprudence and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Islamic finance 2.5 The institution of Waqf 2.6 Care for the Orphans 3.0 Akhlaq  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Islamic Finance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain The Institution of Waqf Types of waqf and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Care for the Orphans 3.0 Akhlaq 3.1 Virtues 3.2 Prohibitions in Islam 4.0 Islami and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
